vehicleFormModal.currencyFixed: Fixed at creation: costs are recorded in this currency for the vehicle's whole life.

vehicleFormModal.currentMileageHelp: Dashboard reading today. Purchase mileage is configured in the contract.
vehicleFormModal.advancedOptionsDesc: Tariff plan, default home charger and estimated consumption
vehicleFormModal.tollDetectionHint: Automatic turns it on where this vehicle drives in France. It detects the motorway tolls of a drive from its GPS trace and lists the motorway drives still to qualify. The reference data covers French motorways only. Tolls entered by hand are always available.
vehicleFormModal.teslamateLater: Using TeslaMate? Once the vehicle is created, connect it from its card, on the TeslaMate connection line.

teslamateConnection.grafanaHint: Adds an “Open in TeslaMate” link in the detail of each drive (Drive Details dashboard).
teslamateConnection.urlHint: Adds a “Set the cost in TeslaMate” link on a charge whose cost is unknown. The cost entered there is read again by the next synchronisation.
teslamateConnection.urlFirst: Please enter the TeslaMate API URL first
teslamateConnection.disconnectMessage: The connection settings are deleted and the vehicle is tracked by hand from now on. Drives and charges already imported are kept.
teslamateConnection.secretKept: Leave empty to keep the saved one.

vehicleMembersModal.yourTeslamateApiKeysAnd: Your TeslaMate API keys and financing data stay hidden from the members.

vehicleMembersModal.leaveMessage: Are you sure you want to leave the vehicle {name}? You will no longer have access to its data.
vehicleMembersModal.driversHint: The people who drive this vehicle, with or without an account. An account can be linked later, keeping the history.
vehicleMembersModal.driverNamePlaceholder: Name of a driver without an account

vehiclesView.deleteMessage: Delete this vehicle and all its history? This cannot be undone.

vehicleDataSourcesModal.title: Data sources

vehicleDataSourcesModal.empty: Nothing recorded for this vehicle yet.

vehicleView.consumptionFuelEmpty: Enter two full tanks to measure it

hybridShare.title: Electric share
hybridShare.intro: The part of your kilometres driven on the battery. It splits the energy cost of each trip between electricity and fuel.
hybridShare.noneAccepted: No value is used yet: your trips have no energy cost until you accept or enter one.

because.not_enough_data: Enter your fill-ups (full tank, with the odometer) and your charges with the odometer: at least 3 full-tank periods and 500 km are needed.
because.energy_and_fuel_not_separable: Your fill-ups and charges do not vary enough to tell electricity from fuel. Enter your consumption on electricity in the vehicle form, or keep entering them.

hybridShare.lowHint: Enter the battery level at the start and end of your charges to make it more reliable.
hybridShare.lessPrecise: {count} synchronized charges lack the energy taken from the plug: they are read on the battery side, a little less precise.
hybridShare.alreadyUsed: This is the value your trips use.
hybridShare.appliesLater: A value applies to the trips you save afterwards. Trips already recorded keep theirs.
hybridShare.capacityDeduced: Battery capacity: about {kwh} kWh, deduced from your charges.
hybridShare.capacityTyped: Battery capacity: {kwh} kWh, as you entered it.
hybridShare.capacityUnknown: Battery capacity: not deduced yet. Enter the battery level at the start and end of a few charges.
hybridShare.capacityHint: Optional: only to correct the capacity deduced from your charges. Leave empty to keep the deduced one.
